## Bio

Beatrice Okrah is a physician,applied statistician AI researcher with a strong commitment to advancing equitable healthcare through data-driven innovation. Her work spans clinical care, machine-learning research, and health-systems strengthening,including co-leading the development of AI-powered diagnostic and clinical decision-support tools for the management of gestational diabetes and stroke in Ghana. She is currently an MPH candidate at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health where she is learning to apply her knowledge to save lives, millions at a time.
